newsitem.title: TURKEY: Dardanelles Straits closed to shipping on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Dardanelles Straits closed to shipping on Friday.

text.p: Western Turkey's Dardanelles Straits were closed to shipping in both directions on Friday to allow for the passage of a floating dock from Italy, shipping officials said.
The straits were expected to reopen to two-way traffic at around 2.00 a.m. on Saturday (2300 GMT Friday), an official at the Dardanelles port authority told Reuters.
Turkish shipbuilder Kahraman Sadikoglu bought the floating dock, described by Anatolian news agency as the world's biggest, from a company in Italy.
The agency said four tugs pulled the 350-metre long dock.
The dock was being taken to Tuzla dockyards near Istanbul on the Sea of Marmara.
